title: Dryer Lint Reminder Overrun
dataSources: LG ThinQ washer cycles (`thinq:washer`), LG ThinQ dryer cycles (`thinq:dryer`), Home Connect dishwasher runs (`homeconnect:dishwasher`), and ecobee HVAC runtime (`ecobee:thermostat`).
app: LG ThinQ washer and dryer telemetry, Home Connect dishwasher data, and ecobee HVAC runtime exported into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=thinq:dryer cycle_count_since_lint_clean=*
| stats max(cycle_count_since_lint_clean) as cycles_since_clean by machine_name
| where cycles_since_clean>10
| sort - cycles_since_clean
description: Flags dryers that have gone too many cycles since the lint trap or path was last recorded as cleaned.
value: Lint is boring right up until it becomes a performance and fire-risk issue, so the reminder should be data-backed.
implementation: Increment a `cycle_count_since_lint_clean` counter on each completed cycle and reset it when cleaning is recorded.
visualization: Single-value or table of dryers by cycles since lint clean.
grandmaExplanation: It watches which dryer has gone too many loads without a proper lint clean-out.
